en.notes: Core i18n package's own bundled runtime strings: language display names and this package's own sentinel error messages.

description.msg: This language's own display name, written in itself (not translated into any other language).
Debug log message emitted when the current language is changed at runtime.

lang.description: the BCP 47 language tag that was set (e.g. "de", "en").

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrDisabled, returned for callers to test with errors.Is when a build or profile intentionally never initializes the i18n manager.
Error message for i18n.ErrLanguageNotSupported, returned when a requested language hasn't been registered as supported by any RegisterTranslation call.

lang.description: the requested, unsupported BCP 47 language tag.

$message.msg: unsupported translation value type {type:T} for key {key:s} in language {lang:s}

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrUnsupportedType, returned when a translation value passed to RegisterTranslation/RegisterTranslations isn't a string, catalog.Message, []catalog.Message, or a Message/nested map of those.

type.description: the Go type of the unsupported value.

key.description: the full translation key the value was registered under.

lang.description: the BCP 47 language tag the value was registered for.

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrReadDir, returned when a translations *FS's root or a language subdirectory within it can't be read.

dir.description: the directory path that could not be read.

$message.msg: expected a translation file, found a directory {name:q} in language {lang:s}

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrUnexpectedDirectory, returned when a translations *FS finds a directory where it expected a translation file.

lang.description: the BCP 47 language tag of the directory being loaded.

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrReadFile, returned when a translation file within a translations *FS can't be read.
Error message for i18n.ErrParseFile, returned when a translation file's content isn't valid JSON.

cause.description: the underlying JSON parse error's message.

$message.msg: could not parse language tag from {source:q}: {cause:s}

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrParseLanguageTag, returned when a translations *FS can't parse a BCP 47 language tag from a file or directory name.

source.description: the file or directory name the language tag was parsed from.

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrInvalidMessage, returned when a JSON $message object is malformed (e.g. a fragment missing its required "other" form).

name.description: the fragment or field name that is invalid.

reason.description: a human-readable explanation of what's wrong.

$message.msg: unsupported or invalid translation schema version for language {lang:s}: {cause:s}

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrInvalidSchemaVersion, returned when a translation file's reserved "$version" key can't be resolved: it names a schema version newer than this build of pkg/i18n supports, isn't a recognizable integer, or a migration up to the current version failed.

lang.description: the BCP 47 language tag the translation file was being registered for.

has_suggestion_f.yes: bundle {bundle:s}: locale {lang:s} has key {key:s} which does not exist in source locale {source:s} (did you mean {suggestion:s}?)
has_suggestion_f.other: bundle {bundle:s}: locale {lang:s} has key {key:s} which does not exist in source locale {source:s}

description.msg: Error message for i18n.ErrUnknownLocaleKey, returned when a non-source locale registers a key that doesn't exist anywhere in its bundle's declared source locale - usually a typo in the key name itself, or a stale key left behind after the source changed.

bundle.description: the bundle (root key) the key was registered under.

lang.description: the BCP 47 language tag of the locale that has the unknown key.

key.description: the unknown key, relative to its bundle.

source.description: the BCP 47 language tag of the bundle's declared source locale.

suggestion.description: the closest matching key found in the source locale, if any.
